body:
## Context

Two release-audit doc-claim BLOCKERS. (1) packages/build-gate/README.md:34 documents the --bytes-threshold default as 262144 (256 KiB); the shipped CLI default is CLI_DEFAULT_BYTES_THRESHOLD = 8 MiB (bin/build-gate.mjs:30, echoed by --help at :63). The divergence from the library export (DEFAULT_BYTES_THRESHOLD = HARD_BYTES = 256 KiB, lib/depth-signal.mjs:30) is intentional and documented in code (bin/build-gate.mjs:20-29); only the README was never updated. npmjs.com renders this README, so an installing operator reads a gate 32x more sensitive than reality, in the silent-green direction. (2) plugins/adlc-codex/README.md:8-9 states a @adlc/cli floor of 1.4.2 (justified only by MCP transport); the handoff gate hard-requires @adlc/context-handoff exports that first ship in 1.11.0 and fails CLOSED below it (REQUIRED_API fail() at adlc-handoff-gate.mjs:1202-1209, before any bypass grant is consulted) — an operator following the documented floor gets every mutating tool call denied. The runtime message is already actionable (#528); the README is what puts users in that state.

## What to change

1. `packages/build-gate/README.md:34` — change the flag-table default to 8388608 (8 MiB); add one sentence noting the library export DEFAULT_BYTES_THRESHOLD remains HARD_BYTES (256 KiB) by design, so the two numbers are not expected to agree.
2. `packages/build-gate/test/cli.test.mjs` — add a README-consistency test: parse the number the binary prints in --help (existing pattern at :140-143) and assert the README table row carries the same number, so they cannot drift again.
3. `plugins/adlc-codex/README.md` — raise the floor: use @adlc/cli 1.11.0 or newer — the handoff gate requires it and fails closed below it (keep the MCP sentence). Add a short handoff-gate section: what it denies, that a missing-export deny means upgrade the CLI, and the `adlc handoff bypass --session <id> --write` recovery path.

## Acceptance criteria

1. README table row states 8388608 and the divergence note is present. verify: `grep -q '8388608' packages/build-gate/README.md` exits 0.
2. README-consistency test exists and is green. verify: `node --test packages/build-gate/test/cli.test.mjs` exits 0.
3. Codex README floor is 1.11.0 with a handoff-gate section. verify: `grep -q '1.11.0' plugins/adlc-codex/README.md && grep -qi 'handoff' plugins/adlc-codex/README.md` exits 0.

SCOPE ADDENDUM (2026-08-22, build-time, approved): the stale 1.4.2 CLI floor was live on five surfaces and PINNED by two existing docs-site tests (apps/docs/test/codex-docs-current.test.mjs:44 concatenation match; integration-facts.test.mjs:240), so the fix necessarily updates those tests and the docs-site content surfaces (codex.mdx, integration-facts.mjs, docs/integrations/codex.md, toolkit/build-gate.mdx — hand-authored page, corrected surgically; build-gate has NO generated docs/tools mirror). apps/docs/content/docs/getting-started.mdx:10 deliberately unchanged — its 1.4.2 claim is accurate for exactly what it names (initializer + MCP entrypoint).
title: doc truth: build-gate README --bytes-threshold default (8 MiB) and codex README CLI floor (1.11.0) match shipped behavior
